title: Prime Minister Delighted That Chelsea and Mrs Rodham Are Accompanying President
content:
10 September 1999

Prime Minister Delighted That Chelsea and Mrs Rodham Are Accompanying President

  • Jenny Shipley
Prime Minister

Prime Minister Jenny Shipley is delighted to learn that the President of the United States, William Jefferson Clinton, will be accompanied on his State visit to New Zealand by his daughter and Mrs Dorothy Rodham.

"We are looking forward to giving them a great time in New Zealand," Mrs Shipley said.
